list: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them, names, descriptions and grades from Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade), frozen 2026-11-18. Guides are this guide's own words, built from the official descriptions and from PowerPyx's trophy guide; every guide names its sources.

roadmap.title: Play the story — and watch the one missable
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel — that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (the only trophy that may be missable). Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter: 15 manual slots, no mission replay.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist — after the credits
roadmap.text: After the story, the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges. All robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks, gold at all 12 shooting ranges, all 42 drone races. Nothing on it is missable.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and the last cleanups
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete), the character questlines, and whatever miscellaneous trophies are left. Then the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks strands and the last cleanups. No online trophy stands between you and it, and nothing on the list is DLC.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1 — just play the opening. No preparation helps, because the game hands it to you.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 — it unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Nothing to prepare; keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it unlocks as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; PowerPyx ties it to the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, the gold for the finale. Finish the final mission — PowerPyx lists it under Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. It is the last story trophy; after it, free-roam opens for cleanup. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable — it comes to you in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the whole point of Step 2. After the story, the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — and progress you made during the story already counts. The requirements are lenient: PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges). Nothing on it is missable, and it is all doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count — the 100% checklist wants 300. Four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. Mix them and take the quickest: PowerPyx says under-the-bridge runs are fastest. Track by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most come naturally from the story and the other trophies, so don't grind it early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a range-by-range guide; the medals are not hard, and range practice also raises your Focus, which helps Gunslinger. Track each range in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations (42 races exist; the 100% checklist wants all of them). PowerPyx maps all 14 spots. One win per location is enough for the trophy — save the full sweep for the checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40 unique race locations — winning the same race twice does not count. PowerPyx lists all 40 spots. Races count toward Master of None too, so fold them into your activity sweep.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge. It stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck. The first three play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of a game — the challenges inside it do not matter.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3, Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. All stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1. After the mission Island Dreams, he calls and is marked 'KR' in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet during parts of the story but returns in Chapters 2–3 (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up). Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five Billy quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. All stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only some questlines count — confirmed: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. All strands stay open after the story; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List. Marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, and deliver in good condition for more money. Cars he marks appear in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. Marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City — destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone's second quest Spin On This shuts the labs down and pops the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable watch. 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts +2. Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx (who earned the trophy after doing it) flags it as the only possibly missable trophy; whether it is required is still unconfirmed, so do it. The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this cannot cost you A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason-only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His first quest gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). Hunt the animals he requests and bring them back; clean one-shot kills pay more but are not required. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx notes it. Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck (15 decks; all 15 are needed for 100%).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations. Cards are a pure collectible hunt — no story gate, so fold it into your exploration.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations — any mix of 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Hold Up + R1 on the phone's WAiNK app to scan what you are looking at. There are far more than 100, so just scan as you travel.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. View them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete passively while chasing other trophies — leave the hard ones; you can skip 10 for the trophy and 10 more for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Earliest after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Cause carnage to 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is PowerPyx's easy route (cops struggle on the tracks, the helicopter cannot see you). It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vaults always bring 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only after Chapter 2's Coffee Break (partner call unlocked). Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while the red/blue flashing wanted level stays up — don't let it drop or spike to full heat. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it doesn't, hit a fourth. Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a couple of items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan) — scanning is enough, you don't need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. 557 vehicles exist at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home, Adrenaline to extend it), then line up 5 enemies — gang operation members work; soldiers, police and civilians don't seem to count. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 and wear body armor. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. It gets easier as you level it, and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes on the airfield. Easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. The trophy pops once you are about 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport — it is delayed, so keep flying.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies (green icons) on unfogged map areas. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (silent lockpick; kicking the door trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — you can't carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first). Each vault pays up to $205,000 and brings 4 stars instantly — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognized. The 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is — robbing the bank vault there counts. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You need all 8 large bank jobs for 100% anyway, so this comes free.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is clear. PowerPyx links a fast-unfog route. Start it during the story and finish it in free-roam.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations. They show as yellow icons when you get near them (many are marked by story progress). Track per gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned down the trigger. The description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach; check back as players crack it. This guide says so plainly when a trigger is confirmed — don't trust a walkthrough that claims to know already.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — most likely driving out through the showroom window. Try the showrooms around Vice City with a fast car; the exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) for the safe. The three: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on pickup — and you don't need all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for what's left. Not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Only after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness-club membership and always work out together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner) — while one trains, the other completes theirs automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a little demon face appears whenever an action counts. Five profiles: Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones), Irredeemable (permanent — avoid pushing that far; cops shoot on sight). It builds passively through robberies and fights; if it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — 'second time's the charm' suggests failing once, then succeeding. Try the Payday Loans jobs again after a failed attempt; the exact trigger is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. PowerPyx believes it is tied to a UFO questline — 'what the hell just happened?' is the game's wink at something strange in the sky. Watch for the UFO strand as players map it; don't trust a guide that already claims the steps.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. PowerPyx believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by that bowls them over. Try melee kicks from a bike at speed; the exact trigger is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts (a running total — not at once). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 per job, so this comes naturally with Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (running total). Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they are the fastest route. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — you will spend it naturally while gearing up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 story garages don't count). Total cost about $160,000. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — you will get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is on your phone, and you buy through it. Robberies are the fastest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need free garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
